# Vendored libraries

Copied unmodified from npm (via jsDelivr), except that the source-map comment lines were removed.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `locomotive-scroll.mjs` | locomotive-scroll (`dist/locomotive-scroll.modern.mjs`) | 5.0.1 | MIT |
| `locomotive-scroll.css` | locomotive-scroll (`dist/locomotive-scroll.css`) | 5.0.1 | MIT |
| `lenis.mjs` | lenis (`dist/lenis.mjs`), required by locomotive-scroll | 1.3.17 | MIT |

`index.html` maps the bare `lenis` import to `vendor/lenis.mjs` with an import map.
To upgrade, download the same files for the new versions and update this table.
